records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.collapsible_splitter.FocusCollapse#4
records.source: A VIEW is one visit to one screen: it begins when the screen is shown (:meth:`begin_view`, from its ``showEvent``) and ends when it is hidden because the user went to another screen (:meth:`end_view`, from its ``hideEvent``). Minimising the window does not end it -- the owner passes only non-spontaneous events. Pins last for the view: returning to the screen with its live preview still open collapses the surroundings again, which is what a fresh arrival at that layout would get.
records.context: A view is one visit to one application view: it begins when the application view is shown (:meth:`begin_view`, from its ``showEvent``) and ends when it is hidden because the user went to another application view (:meth:`end_view`, from its ``hideEvent``). Minimising the window does not end it -- the owner passes only non-spontaneous events. Pins last for the view: returning to the application view with its live preview still open collapses the surroundings again, which is what a fresh arrival at that layout would get.
records.translation: Uma VISUALIZAÇÃO é uma visita a uma tela: começa quando a tela é mostrada (:meth:`begin_view`, a partir de seu ``showEvent``) e termina quando ela é ocultada porque o usuário foi para outra tela (:meth:`end_view`, a partir de seu ``hideEvent``). Minimizar a janela não a termina -- o proprietário repassa apenas eventos não espontâneos. As fixações duram a visualização: voltar à tela com sua pré-visualização ao vivo ainda aberta recolhe o entorno de novo, que é o que uma nova chegada a esse layout receberia.

records.source: THE BODY'S OWN VISIBILITY STAYS ITS OWNER'S. The fold hides an inner holder, never the body, so unfolding cannot show a panel its owner hid or build a panel that is built on first show (items 284/380). The other way round, the section follows its body: while the owner keeps the body hidden the whole section -- heading included -- is hidden too, and it comes back when the owner shows the body. Only the body's hidden flag is read for that, so nothing is shown, measured or built to find out.
